description: React component for rendering user mention suggestions in a chat application, including handling special mentions like 'all', 'channel', 'here', and user groups, with user profile display, status icons, and tags.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Interface extending UserProfile with additional flags for current user, agent, and default agent status.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Interface extending Item with display name, internal name, and member count for user groups.

methods.name: isGroup
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object is a Group.
